title: r35#1 ↻ 再生成 覆盖 ep02

steps.js: const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3-row[data-shot]')]; let ver=0, draft=0, verBtn=0, draftBtn=0, btnW=[], overFace=0; for (const r of rows) { for (const t of [...r.querySelectorAll('.v3-frames .v3-frame')]) { const tag=(t.querySelector('.v3-tag')?.innerText||''); const hasNum=/#\s*\d+/.test(tag); const b=[...t.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText+(b.title||'')+(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||''))); if (hasNum) { ver++; if (b) verBtn++; } else { draft++; if (b) draftBtn++; } if (b) { const br=b.getBoundingClientRect(), tr=t.getBoundingClientRect(); btnW.push(Math.round(br.width)); if (br.top - tr.top > tr.height*0.12) overFace++; } } } const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/↻ 再生成/.test(b.innerText)).length; return {rows:rows.length, versionedTiles:ver, versionedWithBtn:verBtn, otherTiles:draft, otherWithBtn:draftBtn, findByText_innerText:all, btnWidths:[...new Set(btnW)], btnBelowTopBand:overFace};

steps.js: const m=document.querySelector('.ds-modal'); const a=document.activeElement; return {modal:!!m, role:m?.getAttribute('role'), title:m?.querySelector('h2,h3,header')?.innerText, focusIsTextarea:a?.tagName==='TEXTAREA', mode:document.querySelector('.regen-mode')?.innerText};

title: r35#2 ep02 S1 尾帧候选标签 + 候选弹窗

steps.js: const r=document.querySelector('.v3-row[data-shot="ep02-S1"]'); const tiles=[...r.querySelectorAll('.v3-frames .v3-frame')]; const txt=tiles.map(t=>t.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ')); const lbls=tiles.map(t=>[...t.querySelectorAll('.v3-cand-lbl')].map(x=>x.innerText+' | title='+(x.title||''))); const rowAll=r.innerText+' '+[...r.querySelectorAll('[title]')].map(e=>e.title).join(' '); return {tiles:txt, candLabels:lbls, internalInRow:(rowAll.match(/ASSETMASTER|PRODUCER|接手登记/g)||[]), pageInternal:(document.body.innerText.match(/ASSETMASTER|PRODUCER|接手登记/g)||[]).length};

steps.clickAt: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('.v3-row[data-shot="ep02-S1"]'); const t=[...r.querySelectorAll('.v3-frames .v3-frame')][1]; t.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const img=t.querySelector('img')||t; const b=img.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.x+b.width/2, b.y+b.height*0.8]; })()

steps.js: const m=document.querySelector('.ds-modal, [role=dialog]'); if(!m) return {modal:false}; const txt=m.innerText; const titles=[...m.querySelectorAll('[title],[alt],[data-zoom-label]')].map(e=>(e.title||'')+' '+(e.alt||'')+' '+(e.getAttribute('data-zoom-label')||'')).join(' '); return {modal:true, head:txt.slice(0,200).replace(/\s+/g,' '), internal:((txt+' '+titles).match(/ASSETMASTER|PRODUCER|接手登记/g)||[]), hasRecipeLabel:/新配方|旧配方/.test(txt+titles), labels:[...new Set((txt).match(/暂定|新配方|旧配方|候选 ?#\d+/g)||[])]};

title: r35#2 全站候选标签扫 ep01/ep03
